easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least five cards in all hands.
description:
Activate Realm Seekers by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Realm Seekers enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Realm Seekers enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Realm Seekers.
Activate Realm Seekers using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
